page: Microsoft Azure L96s_v4 is a storage-optimized server instance from the Lsv4 family, powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor. This x86_64 architecture system features 96 virtual CPUs across 48 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes a 260 MB L3 cache. The instance is bundled with 23,038 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, making it highly suitable for data-intensive operations.

In benchmark evaluations, the L96s_v4 demonstrates strong multi-core processing capabilities, achieving a top-tier rating in Geekbench multi-core testing and a strong rating in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance. Its memory subsystem delivers uncached read bandwidth of 222.04 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 94.04 GB/sec. The server also excels in high-throughput scenarios, recording top-tier performance in static web serving at 113.25 GB/sec and strong results in Redis SET operations at 102.15 million operations per second.

Given its massive local NVMe SSD capacity and high memory-to-core ratio, this instance is highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring high resource density and rapid local storage access without the overhead of external storage arrays. The presence of Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions supports efficient CPU-based AI workloads, as evidenced by strong prompt processing speeds in medium-sized language models. The hardware profile is optimized for large-scale relational databases, NoSQL data stores, data warehousing, and high-throughput web serving.
